name: AI Straight-line Nerf (EXPERIMENTAL)
author: Kizi
description: EXPERIMENTAL, barely tested. Slows AI cars on straights: less ERS (stock cars, restart) + a live AI power and top-speed cut, mouse panel on F8. Use at your own risk.

options.label: [Experimental] AI ERS: stops deploying at battery
options.description: EXPERIMENTAL, barely tested. The game's own cars only (not cars added by mods). Needs a game restart. Battery level where the AI stops using ERS (game: 10%). Higher = its battery runs dry sooner.

options.label: [Experimental] AI engine power cut (%)
options.description: EXPERIMENTAL, barely tested. Takes this much engine power from every AI car, so they are slower on straights. Corner speed is not touched. 0 = off. Live: no restart, applies within a second.

options.label: [Experimental] AI top speed cut (rpm)
options.description: EXPERIMENTAL, barely tested. AI engine torque is cut this many rpm under the limiter, which caps top speed at the end of long straights. 0 = off. Live: no restart, applies within a second.

options.label: [Experimental] Open the panel when the game is paused
options.description: Opens the mouse panel by itself on pause and closes it on resume. Off: open it with F8 (Esc closes).
